arguments.value: Jeffrey L. Schmehl is a United States District Judge for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, appointed by President Barack Obama in 2013. Born in Reading, Pennsylvania, he earned his B.A. from Dickinson College and his J.D. from the University of Toledo College of Law. Earlier in his career, he served as an assistant public defender and assistant district attorney in Berks County, maintained a private practice in West Reading and Reading, and later served as solicitor for Berks County. He went on to serve as a judge on the Court of Common Pleas of Berks County from 1998 to 2013, including as president judge from 2007 to 2013.
